title: Aerated Pungent Croatian Korean-pear Khao-Khua
description: A hangover-cure dish featuring aerated Khao-Khua, Korean-pear, and pungent Croatian spices. Savory and aromatic, pairs well with a morning brew.
instructions: Heat ghee in a kadhai over medium heat.
Add garlic and saut3; for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add 1 cup of rice to the kadhai and stir to coat with ghee and garlic.
Add 1 cup of water to the kadhai and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
While rice cooks, toast 1 tsp of black sesame seeds in a dry pan over medium heat, stirring frequently.
Grind toasted sesame seeds into a fine powder using a spice grinder.
Stir sesame powder into cooked rice and mix well.
Stir in cayenne pepper, salt, black pepper, and cinnamon.
Stir in diced Korean-pear and cook for 2 minutes, until heated through.
To aerate the Khao-Khua, lift the kadhai off the heat and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes, before fluffing with a fork.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional black sesame seeds if desired.
Adjust seasoning as needed before serving.
